evaluations.evidence: search and discover music using content identification or fingerprinting
evaluations.rationale: This story specifies search via content identification/fingerprinting; no other story expresses the exact same requirement and scope.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music based on my profile
evaluations.rationale: Different search basis (user profile) than other stories; not a duplicate.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music based on other users similar to myself
evaluations.rationale: Specifies collaborative filtering/similar-user basis, distinct from other stories.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music or ringback tones similar to a given music video based on content similarity
evaluations.rationale: Focuses on similarity-to-a-given-music-video and ringback tones; more specific than other music-search stories.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music by exploiting enriched metadata and image tags
evaluations.rationale: Search based on enriched metadata/image tags is distinct from other search strategies in backlog.

evaluations.evidence: upload tagged videos and have tags available for all further processing steps
evaluations.rationale: This is an ingestion/tag-propagation requirement not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: view thumbnail sequences of video segments
evaluations.rationale: Specific UI/visualization need (thumbnail sequences) not expressed elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: get info about similar video items and segments
evaluations.rationale: Expresses the same requirement as ZO-009 (only difference is the word 'perceptually'); no meaningful difference in actor, context, or goal.

evaluations.evidence: get info about perceptually similar video items and segments
evaluations.rationale: Substantially the same requirement as ZO-008; 'perceptually' does not create a meaningful difference in actor, context, or goal.

evaluations.evidence: receive content recommendations from similar profiles
evaluations.rationale: Recommendation-from-similar-profiles is a distinct need (recommendations) compared to search/discovery stories.

evaluations.evidence: receive content recommendations based on most relevant news events in my area
evaluations.rationale: Recommendations based on local news/events is a distinct trigger/source for recommendations.

evaluations.evidence: identify persons in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Person identification and enrichment is distinct from other identification tasks (products, brands, logos).

evaluations.evidence: identify products in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Product identification is a separate detection/classification requirement distinct from person/brand/logo identification.

evaluations.evidence: identify broadcaster logos in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Broadcaster-logo identification is specific and not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: identify brands in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Brand identification is distinct from other identification stories.

evaluations.evidence: take a picture or upload an image, so that I am recommended with videos related to that picture or image
evaluations.rationale: Visual-based recommendation from a user-supplied image is a unique interaction pattern.

evaluations.evidence: walk around, access content using a geographical map and be informed if there are videos covering the area, monuments or any other relevant point of interest
evaluations.rationale: Geolocation/map-based discovery is distinct from other discovery/search stories.

evaluations.evidence: search content items using automatic speech recognition
evaluations.rationale: ASR-based search is a distinct technical approach not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: see, validate and edit segmentation of videos
evaluations.rationale: Manual review/editing of segmentation is a distinct admin capability.

evaluations.evidence: annotate news video segments and extract a topic for each segment
evaluations.rationale: Annotation and topic extraction for news segments is unique compared to other segment-related stories.

evaluations.evidence: filter and rank videos based on A/V quality aspects
evaluations.rationale: Filtering/ranking by A/V quality is a specific admin requirement distinct from others.

evaluations.evidence: get a quick assessment of whether audio material has been edited before the upload
evaluations.rationale: Detecting edited audio is distinct from other audio QA and processing requirements.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter nudity content
evaluations.rationale: Specific prefiltering for nudity is distinct from other prefilter tasks.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter content using search based on low­level asset information
evaluations.rationale: Low-level asset-info-based prefiltering is different from high-level or nudity-specific prefilters.

evaluations.evidence: automatically validated the ingested contents for copyright infringement
evaluations.rationale: Automatic copyright validation is a distinct compliance requirement.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter the content using search on high­level asset information such as metadata and tags either recognized by the system or provided by the user
evaluations.rationale: High-level metadata/tag based prefiltering is complementary but not duplicative of low-level prefiltering.

evaluations.evidence: assess how interesting or appealing or complex a picture is based on automated analysis, citizen annotations, and comments on Talk
evaluations.rationale: Assessment of appeal/complexity via multiple signals is a unique analytic requirement.

evaluations.evidence: detect when a scientist should be prompted to look at a subject, based on annotations and information from Talk comments
evaluations.rationale: Triggering prompts for scientists is a distinct decision-support requirement.

evaluations.evidence: identify volunteer types
evaluations.rationale: Volunteer profiling/clustering is distinct from other admin tasks.

evaluations.evidence: preclassify the Galaxy Zoo images using simple low­level image features
evaluations.rationale: Project-specific preclassification (Galaxy Zoo) is distinct from other project tasks.

evaluations.evidence: automatically detect Snapshot Serengeti images with no classifiable animals in them
evaluations.rationale: Project-specific empty-image detection is unique.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic image series detection for the case of timestamping malfunction in Snapshot Serengeti images
evaluations.rationale: Specific detection for timestamping malfunction is not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic animal species preclassification in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Species preclassification for a specific project is distinct from other preclassification items.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic animal attribute preclassification in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Attribute preclassification (distinct attribute set) differs from species/number detection stories.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic animal number detection in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Counting animals is a distinct automated analysis requirement.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic segmentation or localization of plankton in Plankton Portal
evaluations.rationale: Automatic segmentation/localization for plankton is project-specific and distinct.

evaluations.evidence: automatically detect Plankton Portal images with no classifiable plankton in them
evaluations.rationale: Project-specific empty-image detection differs from other tasks.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic detection of plankton size or orientation in Plankton Portal images
evaluations.rationale: Size/orientation detection is a distinct analytic need for the project.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic preclassification of plankton species in Plankton Portal images
evaluations.rationale: Species preclassification for Plankton Portal is project-specific and not a duplicate.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic worm motion analysis to reduce video duration in Worm Watch Lab
evaluations.rationale: Motion analysis to reduce duration is a unique processing objective.

evaluations.evidence: automatically detect the time in a Worm Watch Lab video where the worm lays an egg
evaluations.rationale: Event-detection (egg-laying) is specific and distinct from other worm-analysis tasks.

evaluations.evidence: detect important features such as areas of flooding, damage, temporary shelters, blocked roads etc in the satellite images
evaluations.rationale: Satellite-image feature detection is a distinct analytic requirement.

evaluations.evidence: assess the probability/weight of a volunteer’s classification based on their experience
evaluations.rationale: Volunteer-weighting by experience is a unique quality/aggregation requirement.

evaluations.evidence: perform prefiltering of the images to remove artefacts such as bright stars and camera read errors
evaluations.rationale: Artefact removal is a distinct preprocessing need not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: detect moving and transient objects in the images
evaluations.rationale: Moving/transient object detection is a specific detection task distinct from others.

evaluations.evidence: remove background noise and distracting sounds from the audio files
evaluations.rationale: Audio denoising is a distinct processing requirement.

evaluations.evidence: group whale calls that are similar
evaluations.rationale: Domain-specific grouping of whale calls is distinct from generic grouping requirements.

evaluations.evidence: identify the number of whales heard in a single audio file
evaluations.rationale: Counting whales in audio is a specific analytic/counting requirement.

evaluations.evidence: know when I should interrupt a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Timing for interruption is distinct from other volunteer-interaction decisions such as educating.

evaluations.evidence: know whether I should interrupt a volunteer with text, an image, or a video
evaluations.rationale: Specifies medium for interruption; adds detail but not a duplicate of other stories.

evaluations.evidence: know when I should educate a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Decision to educate (vs interrupt) is a distinct action and requirement.

evaluations.evidence: know whether I should educate a volunteer with text, an image, or a video
evaluations.rationale: Specifies medium for education; different action (educate) from interruption stories.

evaluations.evidence: know which piece of education I should give to a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Selecting specific educational content is a distinct decision-support requirement.

evaluations.evidence: know when a volunteer has made an interesting comment on a subject
evaluations.rationale: Detecting interesting comments is different from prompting or content decisions.

evaluations.evidence: know when Zoonibot should comment on a subject
evaluations.rationale: Triggering Zoonibot comments is distinct from other Zoonibot behaviors.

evaluations.evidence: know when Zoonibot should give an explanation
evaluations.rationale: Timing for explanations (versus comments) is a distinct behavior requirement.

evaluations.evidence: know what Zoonibot should say to a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Content generation for Zoonibot is a distinct requirement from timing triggers.

evaluations.evidence: group subjects by similarity
evaluations.rationale: Generic subject grouping is expressed at a high level and is not a direct duplicate of project-specific grouping stories.

evaluations.evidence: recommend different projects to volunteers based on their previous experiences
evaluations.rationale: Project recommendation based on volunteer history is a unique personalization requirement.

evaluations.evidence: see a summary of articles, so that I reuse them
evaluations.rationale: Summarization/reuse of articles is a distinct capability not duplicated elsewhere.
